provenance.note: 2026-08-23-4's stored shot (spec/vectors/corpus/2026-08-23-4.json.gz, input.shot, unstamped as every stored shot is) under a DRILL goal, with that swing manifest's club, 7i, and the vector's handedness (right) and loft (30.5); photo_sha256 is the shot's image_sha256. Decision 1: every mode measures a shot alike, so measurements are that vector's recorded launch_monitor:hd_golf and model:flight_v1 rows in their order, with Python's values, and unscored is its flight refusal (flight_landing_offline_yds, spin_axis_unresolved). The vector was recorded under FUNDAMENTALS, so a drill that differed from it anywhere but intent would fail here, and tests/shot.rs re-runs this case under FUNDAMENTALS to hold the difference to intent.mode. intent is the drill with its category filled from the club (7i is mid_iron in contracts::club's CLUB_CATEGORY; the request's goal left the default, all). shot is the vector's expected.swing.shot, the stored shot as the engine writes it: club_head_speed 103.6 and smash_factor 0.87 stay on it and reach no row (shown_only). No note: needs_review is false.
provenance.source: worked by hand in M35 P4, the M35 plan's P4 list; each shot is the named corpus vector's input.shot, edited only as the note says, and Rust's answer (golf_core::run_shot) was checked equal to this expected within RTOL before the file was committed
